name: @leandown/blueprint
description: All-in-one CLI for Lean blueprint projects — Typst documents with Lean formalization tracking

scripts.build: rm -rf dist tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && bun run build:js && bun run build:assets && bun run build:dts
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts src/lean/analyzer.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --packages external
scripts.build:assets: bun build src/assets/page.ts src/assets/graph-renderer.ts --outdir dist/assets --format esm --target browser && cat ../core/lean.css src/styles.css > dist/assets/blueprint.css && mkdir -p dist/typst && cp src/typst/lib.typ dist/typst/lib.typ
